+ This ~ Char

~ \value

.. nul ~
    ~ "null"
        null
.. bool ~
    ~ "true"
        true
    ~ "false"
        false
.. float Float ~
    ~ "-"? "." [0-9]+ ([eE] [+-]? [0-9]+)?
        json-float(it)
    ~ "-"? [0-9]+ ("." [0-9]+) ([eE] [+-]? [0-9]+)?
        json-float(it)
    ~ "-"? [0-9]+ [eE] [+-]? [0-9]+
        json-float(it)
.. int JSON ~
    ~ "-"? "0" !\number-tail
        0
    ~ "-"? [1-9] [0-9]* !\number-tail
        json-integer(it)
.. number-tail ~
    ~ [0-9] | "." | [eE]
.. string String ~
    ~ "\"" head \plain tail \escaped? "\""
        head ++ (tail ?? "")
.. array ~
    ~ "[" \s items \delimited(~ \s "," \s, ~ \value)? \s "]"
        items ?? empty
            .. empty [JSON]

.. object ~
    ~ "{" \s pairs \delimited(~ \s "," \s, ~ \pair)? \s "}"
        if pairs then (pairs as [String = JSON]) else empty
            .. empty [String = JSON]

.. value JSON ~
    ~ \string | \int | \float | \object | \array | \bool | \nul

.. pair ~
    ~ left \string \s ":" \s right \value
        KeyValuePair(left, right)

.. plain String ~
    ~ (!"\"" !"\\" .)*

.. escaped String ~
    ~ parts \escaped-part+
        "".join(parts)

.. escaped-part String ~
    ~ escape \escape text \plain
        escape ++ text

.. escape String ~
    ~ "\\u" high \high-surrogate "\\u" low \low-surrogate
        ((0x10000 + (high - 0xD800) * 0x400 + (low - 0xDC00)) as Char) as String
    ~ "\\u" (\high-surrogate | \low-surrogate)
        "\uFFFD"
    ~ "\\u" unit \code-unit
        (unit as Char) as String
    ~ "\\" c \json-escape-character
        unescape(c)

.. high-surrogate U32 ~
    ~ digits ([dD] [89abAB] [0-9a-fA-F]{2})
        Hex(digits) as U32

.. low-surrogate U32 ~
    ~ digits ([dD] [c-fC-F] [0-9a-fA-F]{2})
        Hex(digits) as U32

.. code-unit U32 ~
    ~ [0-9a-fA-F]{4}
        Hex(it) as U32

.. json-escape-character ~
    ~ [bfnrt"]
    ~ "/"
    ~ "\\"

.. s ~
    ~ \wsnl*

+ to-json String
    - value

match value
    | Null!
        "null"
    | Int~
        "$value"
    | Float~
        "$value"

    | text String
        json-quote(text)
    | list List
        "[$joined]"
        .. joined = ", ".join(items)
        .. items = to-json(each) in list
    | map Map
        "{$joined}"
        .. joined = ", ".join(pairs)
        .. pairs  = <* key, val in map
            "${json-quote(key)}: ${to-json(val)}"
    | Bool {it}
        "true"
    | Bool {it == false}
        "false"
    ??
        "null"

+ json-escaped
    - c Char

match c
    |= '"'
        "\\\""
    |= '\\'
        "\\\\"
    |= '\n'
        "\\n"
    |= '\r'
        "\\r"
    |= '\t'
        "\\t"
    |= '\b'
        "\\b"
    |= '\f'
        "\\f"
    |? c < ' '
        "\\u00${(c as U8 as Hex)[2 .. < 4]}"
    ??
        c as String

    | "f"
        "\f"
    | "/"
        "/"
    | "\\"
        "\\"
    | "\""
        "\""
    ??
        ""

+ This ?! Error

. captures-errors = stderr-mode == ProcessStderr.capture
. pipes = stdio-mode == ProcessStdio.pipe
. leads = group == ProcessGroup.own
. argv =
    * name
    ** args
    -> String[1 + args.length + 1]
. entries = variables ?? environment()
. envp =
    ** entries
    *> "${each[0]}=${each[1]}"
    -> String[entries.length + 1]

. passed = duplicate-descriptors(name, descriptors)
do finally close-descriptors(passed)
. input = I32[2]
. output = I32[2]
if pipes
    input = open-pipe(name)
    output = open-pipe(name)
        catch failure Error
            close-pipe(input)
            ?! failure
. errors = I32[2]
if captures-errors
    errors = open-pipe(name)
        catch failure Error
            if pipes
                close-pipe(input)
                close-pipe(output)
            ?! failure

. redirected = output-file?.fd ?? inherited-stream
. streams = I32[3]
streams[0] = if pipes then input[0] else inherited-stream
streams[1] = if pipes then output[1] else redirected
streams[2] = redirected
if captures-errors
    streams[2] = errors[1]
else if stderr-mode == ProcessStderr.discard
    streams[2] = discarded-stream
. passing = I32[passed.length]
for index in 0 .. < passed.length
    passing[index] = passed[index]
. child = C:yumiSpawn
    - name
    - argv
    - envp
    - directory ?? ""
    - streams
    - passing
    - passed.length
    - if leads then 1 else 0
if child < 0
    if pipes
        close-pipe(input)
        close-pipe(output)
    if captures-errors
        close-pipe(errors)
    ?! IOError("Unable to run $name: ${C:strerror(-child)}")

. captured File?
if captures-errors
    C:close(errors[1])
    captured = File(errors[0])
if !pipes
    = This(child, null, null, captured, leads)
C:close(input[0])
C:close(output[1])
= This(child, File(output[0]), File(input[1]), captured, leads)

+ do wait Int?
    - sem Semaphore?

` Waits for the process to end and gives its exit status. It gives none where the listener `sem`
` names is cancelled, and ends the waiting task where that task is cancelled.
=? status if is-reaped

. semaphore-pointer Pointer
if sem
    semaphore-pointer = sem.native-pointer
. cancelled = C:yumiSuspendActiveTaskUntilProcExit(pid, semaphore-pointer)
if !cancelled
    if !is-reaped
        . result = I32[1]
        C:waitpid(pid, result, 0)
        status = exit-status(result[0])
        is-reaped = true
    = status
end-if-canceled()

+ do wait-usage ProcessUsage? ?! IOError

?! IOError("Process $pid was already waited for")
    if is-reaped
if C:yumiSuspendActiveTaskUntilProcExit(pid, null)
    end-if-canceled()
    = null
. usage = ProcessUsage[1]
. error = C:yumiReapProcess(pid, usage)
?! IOError("Unable to wait for process $pid: ${C:strerror(error)}")
    if error != 0
. reaped = usage[0]
status = if reaped.signal != 0 then signaled-status-base + reaped.signal else reaped.exit-code
is-reaped = true
= reaped

` Ends the active task where a wait for the process found it cancelled, after taking the wait off
` the event loop, which would otherwise resume a task that has ended once the process exits.

if canceled
    C:yumiCancelProcExitEventListener(pid, null)
check-task-cancelation(canceled)

+ do kill-tree

. tree [Int]
if leads-group
    C:kill(-pid, C:SIGSTOP)
    tree ++= process-group-members(pid)
if !is-reaped && !(tree has pid)
    tree += pid
. index Index = 0
while index < tree.length
    for child in process-children(tree[index])
        if !(tree has child)
            C:kill(child, C:SIGSTOP)
            tree += child
    index += 1
for member in tree
    C:kill(member, C:SIGKILL)
if leads-group
    C:kill(-pid, C:SIGKILL)

_ do listed-processes [Int]
    - by-group Bool
    - value Int

. capacity Size = 64
while true
    . pids = I32[capacity]
    . count = if by-group then C:yumiProcessGroupMembers(value, pids, capacity) else C:yumiChildProcesses(value, pids, capacity)
    =? List'Int() if count <= 0
    if count < capacity
        . listed [Int]
        for index in 0 .. < count
            listed += pids[index]
        = listed
    capacity *= 2

_ do duplicate-descriptors ?! IOError
    - name String
    - descriptors [I32]

. floor = 3 + (descriptors.length as I32)
. copies = List'I32()
for descriptor in descriptors
    . copy = C:yumifcntl(descriptor, C:F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC, floor)
    if copy == -1
        close-descriptors(copies)
        ?! IOError("Unable to pass descriptor $descriptor to $name")
    copies.append(copy)
= copies
